data.name: Error_tags_unsupported_version
data.value: The file's tags use an old format that CrateEdit cannot edit safely. The file was not changed.

data.name: Error_tags_unsupported_feature
data.value: The file's tags use a feature that CrateEdit does not support. The file was not changed.

data.name: Error_tags_malformed
data.value: The file's tags are damaged or in an unexpected format. The file was not changed.

data.name: Error_tags_encoded_frame
data.value: CrateEdit cannot change the {0} of this file because it is stored in a special format that CrateEdit cannot edit safely. The file was not changed.
data.comment: Error tags.encoded-frame. {0} is the field name as shown in the table, e.g. Artist.

data.name: Error_tags_duplicate_frame
data.value: This file contains the {0} twice, so it is unclear which one other programs show. CrateEdit did not change the file.
data.comment: Error tags.duplicate-frame. {0} is the field name as shown in the table, e.g. Artist.

data.name: Error_Unknown
data.comment: Fallback for an error code without a message. {0} is the error code.
